HowItWorks.title: How it works

rules.questions: Each game has {count} statements about Claude Code. For each one, answer True or False within {seconds} seconds.
rules.levels: Pick a level: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced or Mixed (3 beginner, 4 intermediate and 3 advanced questions).
rules.timeout: If time runs out, the answer counts as wrong.
rules.feedback: After each answer you see the correct answer, an explanation and a link to the official documentation.
rules.keyboard: Keyboard shortcuts: {trueKey} = True, {falseKey} = False, Enter = next.
rules.serverClock: The clock runs on the server: reloading the page resumes the same question without restarting the timer.

scoring.base: Base points per correct answer: {beginner} for Beginner, {intermediate} for Intermediate and {advanced} for Advanced. In Mixed, each question is worth its own level's base.
scoring.time: Time bonus: up to 50% of the base, proportional to the time left.
scoring.streak: Streak bonus: from the 3rd correct answer in a row, +10% of the base per answer, up to +50%.
scoring.wrong: A wrong answer or timeout scores 0 and resets the streak.

HowItWorks.maxScore: Theoretical maximum score: {points, number} points (Advanced level, 10 out of 10, answering instantly).
HowItWorks.leaderboard: When you finish, you have 30 minutes to add the game to the leaderboard with a nickname. No account needed.
